messages:
diego (Eng): Quick one  I'm heading to Iceland for a 6-week writing retreat (Jan 10 -> Feb 20). Need to know if I should declare and how the WFH stipend / tax will work. Also asking about intermittent co-working fees.
marta (People Ops): Yes, please declare any stay >30 days. Use the homebase-declare form so we can log payroll & equipment. Link: https://hr.redwood.example/homebase-declare
diego (Eng): If I pay a coworking membership for part of the stay, can Redwood reimburse that as an expense or does it affect stipend?
olivia (Finance): Coworking is an expense claim, separate from the monthly WFH stipend. Submit an expense with receipts. Reimbursement is subject to usual approval and must be reasonable. It won't change stipend calculation.
diego (Eng): Good. About taxes  Iceland has different rules; will payroll switch withholding or is this treated as short-term nonresident work?
marta (People Ops): We'll send your form to our payroll/tax vendor for review. International short-term stays can create reporting obligations. Expect feedback within 7 business days.
it-support: For equipment, if you need a power adapter or ethernet dongle we can send. For shipping laptops internationally, open an equipment ticket and attach the declare form; shipping allowance is $150 for international temporary moves.
diego (Eng): I've submitted the form. hr-bot: "homebase-declare" submitted by diego at 2935551234. Next steps: People Ops review -> Payroll/TAX review (7 business days) -> Equip ticket if requested.
olivia (Finance): Once tax vendor reviews, we'll post whether stipend must be grossed-up or reported in Iceland. Also confirm whether payroll needs to route through a local payroll entity. We'll update here by 2935551280.
marta (People Ops): Manager ack not required for a short international stay but please cc them on the form. If you extend beyond 90 days we need manager signoff and Legal review.
diego (Eng): Thanks all. I'll open an equipment ticket for an international power adapter and travel insurance request.
it-support: Noted  please include shipping address and passport scan if shipping laptop.
marta (People Ops): All set from POps; we'll post payroll's determination when available. Have a great retreat! :globe_with_meridians:
